name: Philips CD-i
significance: Infamous for licensing iconic Nintendo franchises (Mario and Zelda) during the aborted SNES-CD alliance, resulting in legendary full-motion video cutscenes.

editorialContent.overview: Philips' interactive multimedia standard intended as an all-in-one educational, encyclopedia, and interactive movie player.
